business_question: When a completed Task started with an applicable active rule, how often did Atlas actually apply an eligible rule?
denominator: Completed, non-test Tasks with at least one explicit eligible_rule_id at Task start
exclusions: first scenarios with no eligible rule
test Tasks explicitly marked with actor=test or tool=atlas-test
grain: one completed Task with one latest explicit task_rule_evaluated event
limitations: A rule match does not mean the user was satisfied with the result.
User correction remains a separate Label and does not erase the recorded match.
Coverage is partial for Ledger history before explicit Task rule evaluation events.
numerator: Eligible completed Tasks where applied_rule_ids intersects eligible_rule_ids
